# Task pack: database-migration

Prisma/Mongoose schema or migration change.

**Trigger keywords:** prisma, schema, migration, model, column, table, mongoose, backfill, database

## Reviewers to involve
- `agents/database-reviewer.md`
- `agents/migration-reviewer.md`

## Validation lane
- `cd apps/<service> && npx prisma migrate dev --name <name>`
- `npm run affected:test`

## Known pitfalls
- Migrations must be additive/reversible
- Each service owns its DB — no cross-DB queries
- Repository files never throw
